messages:
Nora (SRE): Following up from today's all-hands Q&A re: the inference router incident (INC-2026-060). RCA posted here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-060. Using this thread for short updates + owners.
Dev (eng): Quick ask: can someone give a 2-line customer-friendly summary we can hand to AEs?
Nora (SRE): Customer summary (suggested): "We experienced a routing mismatch after a metadata tagging change, which caused increased latency for some dedicated customers in ap-southeast for ~2.8 hours. We applied a targeted rollback and safeguards; no customer data was lost."
Kim (product): Thanks. Leadership wants: 1) explicit owners + dates in this thread, 2) confirmation we have outreach plan.
Jamie (CEO): Also: please list the prevention policy we will publish internally as a single sentence.
Nora (SRE): Owners & ETAs below. I'll update the all-hands follow-up tracker after edits. Prevention policy (one-liner): "All registry tag changes must pass alias-consistency checks and a canary deploy before affecting router mappings."
Nora (SRE): Action 1: Add alias-consistency check to registry CI (block on mismatch)  Owner: Dev (eng)  ETA: 2026-04-01.
Nora (SRE): Action 2: Update router runbook with rollback playbook and detection shortcuts  Owner: Ravi (infra)  ETA: 2026-03-29.
Nora (SRE): Action 3: Draft and send customer outreach for impacted accounts  Owner: Kim (product)  ETA: 2026-03-28.
Nora (SRE): Action 4: Add an automated canary that compares alias->variant mapping between registry and router during deploys  Owner: Dev (eng)  ETA: 2026-04-05.
Dev (eng): I have a quick validation script prototype. Will open PR and tag SRE/infra. Snippet: 
```
# alias_check.sh
REG_URL=$1
ALIAS=$2
curl -s $REG_URL/aliases | jq -e ".[] | select(.name==\"$ALIAS\")" >/dev/null
```
Kim (product): opsbot, pull impacted-account list so we can prioritize outreach and include AEs.
opsbot: Impact summary: 11 accounts affected. Link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-060
Ravi (infra): I'll start the runbook edits today and include a quick detection query for alias drift in PromQL. Tagging @Dev for review.
Dev (eng): Opening PR now: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4389  includes unit tests for alias_check and CI integration.
Kim (product): Draft customer message ready; posting to #customer-comms for review in 20m. Will include account list and suggested timeline for outreach.
Jamie (CEO): Please ensure the AE team is looped and that the outreach is prioritized for high-value accounts first.
Nora (SRE): Note for retrospective: schedule a 30-minute postmortem sync with eng+infra+product to review rollout safeguards. Proposed time: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT.
Dev (eng): Also proposing a small telemetry change: tag alias-resolution path in traces so we can quickly see mismatches in future incidents. I'll include it in the PR description.
Ravi (infra): For the runbook, adding an immediate mitigation step: toggle router-fallback-to-stable-variant. Adding CLI snippet in playbook.
Kim (product): Once outreach is sent, please drop confirmation here with tick and link to sent message.
opsbot: Tracker updated: all-hands follow-up doc entry created for INC-2026-060. Link: https://redwood.internal/allhands/followups/2026-03-26
Nora (SRE): Marking this thread as canonical for short owner updates. If an owner changes ETA, please edit the follow-up tracker so leadership sees it in one place. :white_check_mark:
